title: Elf o Karu Monotachi
native_title: エルフを狩るモノたち
overview:
The popular anime "Elf o Karu Monotachi" comes to the Sega Saturn. This time, strip them all in the game!

This command-selection adventure is based on the anime and features character designs by Keiji Goto. Stranded in a fantasy world, karate fighter Junpei, actress Airi and tank-driving Ritsuko must hunt for the scattered pieces of a spell that can send them home to Japan - and the fragments are marked on the skin of elves. Choose Look, Talk, Use and Move commands to explore and question the locals, and the characters answer your actions with lines and reactions of their own.

- Plenty of animated movies and event scenes
- A voice cast of 24, with story elements made just for the game
- Two discs, memory backup save

人気アニメ「エルフを狩るモノたち」がセガサターンに登場。
今度はゲームで脱がせまくり！
